title: ArcCivs181-190 navigation territory maintenance and exact-slot control relocation
assumptions: Runtime0.1.180 is the baseline.0.1.181 changes navigation, natural vegetation maintenance and physical control placement; production rates, recipe quantities, reward chances and paid accepted jobs are unchanged.

Participants1/7/16 settlements and maintenance events1/100/10000 per settlement-day are sensitivity inputs, not measured throughput. Every direct currency and player XP amount is zero before and after.

Vegetation writes AIR with physics=false and has no drop, item, XP, Stock or inventory issuance. Productive forester groves and already accepted forestry jobs stay protected; removal consumes finite existing natural world trees without creating saleable items.

Control relocation moves exact existing native slots and NBT from one27-slot barrel to another; no resource reward, item refund or inventory rewrite is allowed. Per-item conservation is checked by native receipt tests, not an invented exchange rate.

Bulk chunk snapshots and faster routing can increase completed legitimate work per hour. The scale is unmeasured before delivery; per-action yields, debits, resident skill and existing supply caps are unchanged. Native comparable route and paid-commit observations are required separately.

Existing-gate maintenance issues no items or resources. Future generated flat-gate material sinks are assessed separately in gate-refit-economy-20261101.json; stepped existing gates retain their exact native floor.

No combined currency unit or item SELL quote is used. Active SELL/AutoSell and planned SELL-to-contract remain separate; no downstream sales, savings or new earning potential are inferred from zero direct money mint.

185 aligns detached flat WALK admission with unchanged native crossed-support checks. An exact891-cell stair capture previously produced first-frame path-changed with zero motion; the corrected local replay arrives in10ticks. This is a local geometry regression, not a measured full live trip or earning multiplier. All direct currency, item, Stock, XP and per-action quantities remain unchanged.

186 places new furniture on a dry authored bottom slab by completing only the matching slab directly beneath the barrel to a double slab through the existing durable pendingControls receipt. Before: a half-height finite world slab and an exterior control. After: one matching full-height finite support and an interior control; adjacent half-height walking surfaces remain unchanged. This adds one finite half-slab of world geometry per such relocation, with zero item drops, issued items, inventory/Stock/Vault/token/player-XP changes. Exact existing cargo slots and NBT still move through the same receipt; no earning or SELL conversion is inferred.

187 retains a legal current control before prioritizing full-support new spares. An already accepted queued upgrade defers new control relocation until the queued design is activated or retired; durable existing relocation recovery still completes. Typed upgrade registration retirement removes only exact changing owned source registrations after native empty-slot evacuation is durable, including a strictly proved initially empty source. All pre-existing item slots and NBT are conserved; a late native refill/state/permission mismatch refuses registry publication. Removed empty physical holders are changed only by the ordinary paid upgrade. Registration count/capacity is not a money unit or an issued resource; no before/after production or SELL multiplier is claimed. Wall infill now waits for an unaccepted same-city search to retire before ordinary admission; the native complete bill stays26STONE_BRICKS+2DARK_OAK_FENCE, with0 direct Vault/tokens/XP or free materials.

188 aligns cargo pickup eligibility with the existing accepted upkeep input request for an ACTIVE builder hut when no paid construction order is active. Before: the trusted dispatcher can reserve16existingCOBBLESTONE but pickup rejects stale-delivery; after: the same bounded request transfers those existing items source→carrier→target through unchanged exact receipts. Source+carrier+target item amounts/NBT remain conserved; the existing input cap, stock capacity, per-action outputs, prices, rewards and currency rules do not change. Completed legitimate upkeep per hour may increase; no income multiplier is measured. An explicit validated wall SITE can append to the ordinary FIFO while selected road work is pending; actual queue activation retains road-maintenance priority. Full native bill remains26STONE_BRICKS+2DARK_OAK_FENCE, with no free paste, resources, work credit, Vault, tokens or XP.

189 treats world-busy construction scanner admission as a transient five-second retry of the same accepted row and gives a persisted legacy world-busy pause one guarded retry after normal access/chunk checks. Before: an ordinary finite admission rejection can strand the paid order indefinitely. After: existing work, bill, reserved payment, per-row debit and native placement checks remain unchanged; no work credit, item or currency is issued. Workshop allocation now consults the same captured production-output headroom used by the native commit instead of ordinary input/cargo capacity. Before: reserve-only slots can cause repeated impossible craft attempts. After: the same pending recipe waits for usable room and recovers when it exists, preserving carried inputs and native receipts. Per-action output amounts, two-slot headroom, prices, resource reserves and all currency rules remain unchanged. Direct before/after Vault, tokens and player XP remain separately zero. Restored legitimate progress is not a measured production or SELL multiplier.

189 carried-meal sessions preserve the exact observed fractional feet on paths, slabs and stairs and validate native support/body/fire before cancelling an existing work route. The same location witness is rechecked before the ordinary delayed meal receipt. Before: integer rounding can refuse the session after cancelling navigation every five seconds. After: accepted eating consumes the same food once; walking, denied sessions, unsupported/moved/obstructed late sessions earn no meal, health, skill, work credit or resource. No food batch, nutrition, consumption duration, currency or earning rate changes. Tavern authored approach/seat handling remains on its existing branch.

189 road infrastructure only uses an optional raw-route downhill hint when the same column and height still exist in the final permitted paving floors. Before: a protected omitted or accepted regraded neighboring column can violate the strict pavement precondition and abort the whole infrastructure request. After: an inconsistent hint uses the existing actual-neighbor/fallback pavement choice; protected/occupied columns remain excluded, accepted paid infrastructure is unchanged, strict pathPavement contracts remain intact. No resource bill, item issuance, work credit, currency, XP, foundation allowance or production parameter changes. Direct before/after amounts remain separately zero in all assessed units.

190 permits the ordinary producer output-return route before a full64-unit stack only when the current accepted construction is WAITING_MATERIALS and the producer already has enough exportable excess of that exact awaited material to cover min(current-row total requirement,64). Before: V4 has71carriedCOBBLESTONE,32reserve and39exportable, while its accepted row awaits12 and its quarry barrel holds exactly32reserve; waiting for64exportable can strand the build despite existing usable material. After: the same existing excess can return through the ordinary own-barrel receipt and courier pipeline. This is a finite transfer of existing items, not production, a grant or an advance of work. The32producer reserve,64maximum shipment, per-action yields/debits, accepted row cost, item metadata and exact pickup/dropoff receipts remain unchanged. No-await, other-material and insufficient-excess cases retain normal batching. Direct before/after Vault, tokens and player XP are separately zero; delivery latency can improve, while actual hourly throughput and downstream SELL remain unmeasured.
